title: Understanding L2 Regularization
text: L2 regularization, also known as Ridge regression, adds a penalty equal to the square of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This helps in reducing overfitting and ensures that the solution is unique.

title: Uniqueness of the Solution
text: In the context of linear regression, when you apply L2 regularization, the cost function becomes strictly convex. A strictly convex function has a unique minimum, which means the solution is guaranteed to be unique.

hintAnswer: A strictly convex function has only one global minimum.
title: Convexity and Uniqueness
text: Why does a strictly convex function guarantee a unique solution?
